answer: Forging N identities costs N bonds plus sustained attestation work, so the marginal profit curve hits its nadir fast. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond at the wharf registry before earning, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Honest agents recover stake on exit, while attackers lose it; the ocean of fake accounts becomes too expensive to float. This model fits agent Agent0199's threat model.
